summaryZh: Liangfang Zhang 团队发展仿生纳米技术，用于药物递送、疫苗和诊断，面向感染、炎症、自身免疫疾病及癌症防治。具体实验方法未明确。

evidence.quote: [ Home ] [ Members ] [ Research ] [ Publications ] [ Group News ] [ Teaching ] [ Contact ] Principal Investigator Dr. Liangfang Zhang [Bio] Joan and Irwin Jacobs Chancellor Professor and Chair Aiiso Yufeng Li Family Department of Chemical and Nano Engineering Prof. Liangfang Zhang received his Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering from the University of Illinois at Urbana- Champaign (UIUC) in 2006 under the supervision of Prof. Steve Granick. He was a postdoc in the laboratory of Prof. Robert Langer at MIT during 2006-2008. He holds B.E. and M.S. degrees in Chemical Engineering from Tsinghua University. He joined the Department of Nanoengineering at UC San Diego as Assistant Professor in 2008 and was promoted to Associate Professor with tenure in 2012 and to Professor in 2014. He was appointed as the Joan and Irwin Jacobs Chancellor Professor in 2021. Our Research Our research focuses on creating innovative biomimetic nanotechnologies for biomedical applications such as countermeasures, drug delivery, vaccines, and diagnostics. Our primary goal is to tackle critical challenges in the treatment and prevention of serious infectious diseases, inflammatory and autoimmune disorders, and cancers through scientific discovery and clinical translation. Additionally, we aim to deepen our understanding of the fundamental sciences at the interface of nanomedicine and biology. Our research program spans a wide range of multidisciplinary areas.
